name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Hold the weight at shoulder height, then press up.
start_cue.hi: Weight kandhe par rakho, phir upar dhakelo.

good.en: Good. You went down low enough.

fix.en: Lower the weight to ear height.
fix.hi: Weight kaan ki height tak lao.

above.en: Go lower, down to ear height.
above.hi: Neeche jao, kaan ki height tak.

below.en: Not below ear height. Stop there.
below.hi: Kaan se neeche nahi. Wahin ruko.

almost.en: Lower the weight to ear height.
almost.hi: Weight kaan ki height tak lao.

fix.en: You are leaning back. Keep your ribs down.
fix.hi: Aap peeche jhuk rahe hain. Ribs neeche rakho.

almost.en: You are leaning back. Keep your ribs down.
almost.hi: Aap peeche jhuk rahe hain. Ribs neeche rakho.

fix.en: Too fast. Lower under control. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche control se aao. 2 tak gino.

below.en: Too fast. Lower under control. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche control se aao. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.

fix.en: One arm is much lower. Move both arms together.
fix.hi: Ek haath bahut neeche hai. Dono haath saath chalao.

almost.en: One side is a little behind. Move them together.
almost.hi: Ek side thoda peeche hai. Dono saath chalao.
